name: Dockrr
description: More from Dash to Dock: GNOME's app folders in the dock (a folder icon that opens a pop-up grid of its apps, with unread badges and no separate icons for the apps inside); the song playing now, in a card at the dock's end with its cover, previous / play-pause / next and a progress line; and your own app icons and window classes, from an app's right-click menu or a file, kept through the apps' updates. Formerly Dock Folders.
